body: N3ON sat down with @lildurk father for a conversation as the Chicago rapper continues to fight a federal m*rder-for-hire case in court. With Durk’s future hanging in the balance, his father opened up about the stress & nervousness of the possible outcome and said he’s staying in prayer while waiting for the jury to make its decision. 🏽 Is lil Durk coming home? Allegations are not findings of guilt.
